programme.title: Dark Planet
programme.desc: Two sides, one known as the Alphas and the other the Rebels, struggle in a brutal war on Earth and in outer space. Starring Paul Mercurio and Michael York.

programme.title: Dot Com Mom
programme.desc: In this fish out of water tale, a traditional Indian house wife, visits her successful son in the USA but this simple mother cannot cope with the modern ways and soon finds herself in trouble.

programme.title: Displacement
programme.desc: A young physics student must find a way to reverse a deadly quantum time anomaly and solve the murder of her boyfriend while battling short-term memory loss and time slips caused by the event. - Starring Courtney Hope, Susan Blakely, Bruce Davison

programme.title: Combat Girls
programme.desc: Marisa, a 20-year-old German girl, hates foreigners, Jews, cops, and everyone she finds guilty for the decline of her country. She provokes, drinks, fights and her next tattoo will be a portrait of Adolf Hitler.

programme.title: Divorce Invitation
programme.desc: Mike Christian, a happily married man runs into his high school sweetheart Alex, and after all these years, sparks still fly. When Mike is determined Alex is his true soul mate, he realizes he has a huge problem-he signed an iron-clad pre-nuptial agreement and his wife will not let him out of the marriage. Starring Jamie-Lynn Sigler, Jonathan Bennett, Elliott Gould

programme.title: Der Bunker
programme.desc: A young student seeks quiet and solitude to focus on an important work but ends up as the teacher of a peculiar boy who is home-schooled by his parents in an isolated bunker mansion.

programme.title: Death Of A Soldier
programme.desc: Based on a true story, James Coburn portrays a military lawyer assigned to defend a confessed psychotic killer. Set in WWII and the uneasy US-Australian military alliance. The accused killer claims to have killed 3 women in order to possess their voices. Starring James Coburn, Bill Hunter and Reb Brown

programme.title: Der Samaurai
programme.desc: Der Samurai is a German mind-bender about shape-shifting cross-dressers, bloody decapitations, repressed sexual desires and small town life.

programme.title: From Other Worlds
programme.desc: A depressed Brooklyn housewife sleepwalks through her life until she is abducted by UFOs. Determined to solve the mystery of her otherworldly experiences, she embarks on a journey that leads to both romance and a new meaning of life. Starring Cara Buono, Jay Oakerson, Isaach De Bankolé

programme.title: Impossible Crimes
programme.desc: An experienced detective investigates a series of implausible murders. Things get a turn when a young nun, Caterina, confesses that she believes herself to be the killer.

programme.title: If He Hollers
programme.desc: A bachelorette party goes way out of control when four girls decide to kidnap a brooding cowboy.

programme.title: Interchange
programme.desc: A forensic photographer retreats from the world after witnessing the aftermath of a bizarre murder. When a similar murder occurs, he is asked by a detective to help unravel the mystery that involves corpses drained of blood, peculiar and unexplainable feathers and antique photographs that appear to capture his beautiful neighbor decades before she could have been alive.
